changes.from: Secret-aware API proxying: extend eavs to resolve kyz secret references and inject credentials at transport layer

## Summary

~~Extend eavs with credential proxying~~ -- REVISED: the proxy endpoint belongs on **oqto-runner**, not eavs.

Eavs is a shared central service. kyz vaults are per-user. The runner already runs as the target user and has access to their kyz vault. The credential proxy naturally lives on the runner.

```
eavs  = LLM proxy       (shared, multi-user, central)
runner = agent lifecycle + credential proxy  (per-user, has vault access)
kyz   = encrypted vault  (per-user, storage only)
```

## Architecture

```
Agent -> runner /v1/proxy -> runner reads user's kyz -> inject cred -> target API
         (per-user process)  (user's own vault)
         
Agent -> eavs /v1/chat/completions -> LLM providers    (unchanged)
```

## Runner Proxy API

```
POST /v1/proxy
{
  "url": "https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges",
  "method": "POST",
  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
  "body": {"amount": 2000, "currency": "usd"},
  "credential": {
    "ref": "stripe/api-key/value",   // kyz service/key/field
    "inject": "bearer"               // bearer | basic | header:X-Api-Key | query:key | body:api_key
  }
}

Response: upstream API response passed through (status, headers, body)
```

```
GET /v1/credentials
Returns metadata only (service, key, field names, pinned hosts). Never values.
```

## Security

- Runner runs as the target user -- natural access to their kyz vault
- Secret values never returned to agent (structurally impossible)
- Host pinning, SSRF protection, redirect auth stripping
- Audit log: JSONL with timestamp, session ID, target URL, credential ref, HTTP status

## Integration

- Runner already exposes a socket to the agent (runner protocol)
- Add /v1/proxy and /v1/credentials to that socket
- Runner injects CREDENTIAL_PROXY_URL into agent env
- Pi skill or MCP tool wraps the call for agent ergonomics

## Note

This issue is now misplaced in the eavs repo -- should be moved to oqto-runner. Keeping here for traceability until moved.
changes.to: Generalize secret resolution: a SecretProvider trait + registry keyed on a ref scheme, reusing eavs's existing provider-prefix pattern (resolved_api_key already does env:/keychain:/literal). A secret ref is '<scheme>:<path>', dispatched to a backend, resolved value cached with a TTL, never logged. kyz is the FIRST provider (byteowlz default for oqto); the injection engine and config are backend-agnostic. Env/file schemes serve dev. Additional backends are a separate child. This is the resolution layer the substitution engine (eavs-w6wg.3) calls.

changes.from:
Layer credential injection onto the transparent egress proxy (eavs-frd8, now complete). Today the transparent listener does capture + allow/deny + splice (passthrough); it never sees inside TLS, so it cannot inject secrets. This epic adds selective MITM for explicitly-configured hosts so the agent only ever holds PLACEHOLDER tokens while eavs substitutes the real credential at the transport layer for the matching allowlisted host -- the gondolin createHttpHooks model, backed by the kyz vault.

Invariant: the real secret NEVER enters the agent (env, memory, fs). The agent env carries a high-entropy placeholder; eavs swaps in the real value only for the destination that secret is scoped to, only after TLS termination, and blocks any real value heading to a non-allowlisted host (anti-exfil).

Scope boundaries:
- MITM only the hosts configured for injection; everything else stays splice/passthrough (preserves perf and does not break cert-pinned clients).
- HTTP(S) only (placeholder substitution needs a request to rewrite). SSH/DB wire protocols are out of scope.
- Cross-repo touchpoint: the agent must trust eavs's MITM CA -- oqto-sandbox installs it into the agent's trust store / SSL_CERT_FILE; eavs generates/serves the CA.

Reference: external-repos/gondolin/host/src/http/hooks.ts (createHttpHooks, applySecretsToRequest, assertSecretValuesAllowedForHost). Builds on the transparent listener in src/transparent.rs.

Definition of done: an agent holding a placeholder reaches an allowlisted host through eavs, the real kyz-resolved credential is injected and upstream returns 200; the same placeholder/real value sent to a non-allowlisted host is blocked; secrets never appear in logs or the agent; audit records every injection.

changes.from: Port the gondolin secret model (external-repos/gondolin/host/src/http/hooks.ts). Per secret: a high-entropy placeholder (the agent's env value) + a host allowlist + the real value (from kyz). On a terminated request: replace placeholder->real in headers (and optionally URL query) ONLY when the request host matches that secret's allowlist; inject at the last moment after any rewriting. Anti-exfil: assertSecretValuesAllowedForHost -- block a request already carrying a real secret value bound for a non-allowlisted host (redirect hops). Keep SSRF/internal-range blocks. Unit-testable as a pure request->request transform. Blocked by config schema + kyz resolution.
